plan: Lyonesse II acts as bait holding at Medium range while transmitting the sensor picture to the ambush force. Invigilator and Death's Actuary spring the trap, burning full thrust to intercept and close to Short range on HMS Executor. Cicada stands off clear of the engagement area.

intents.rationale: Stand off safely out of Executor's direct fire reach until interceptors engage.
Close with Invigilator to ambush Executor and eliminate her weapons.
Spring the ambush, closing rapidly to Short range to cripple Executor's drive and particle barbette.
Hold the bait at Medium range, evade incoming fire, share contact data, and return fire with pulse lasers.

plan: Disengage from close range with the distressed yacht and open the distance to the pirate ambushers. Open range to Very Long band where Executor's particle barbette and missiles dominate while out of enemy laser reach, adopting Silent posture once range opens to regain stealth.

intents.rationale: Open range to shake yacht contact and back off from incoming pirate blips to Very Long reach while disabling the yacht's threat.

plan: Invigilator and Death's Actuary continue burning full thrust to intercept HMS Executor and close the range. Lyonesse II fires pulse lasers and attempts to repair its manoeuvre drive while surviving. Cicada launches missiles at HMS Executor from safe standoff distance.

intents.rationale: Launch missiles at HMS Executor while maintaining standoff distance.
Intercept HMS Executor at maximum thrust and engage with beam lasers if in reach.
Intercept HMS Executor at maximum thrust to bring beam turrets to bear.
Fire pulse lasers at Executor at Medium range and attempt to restore manoeuvre drive function.

plan: Continue opening the range out to Very Long against the ambushers while using active sensors to detect and lock onto the pirate ships (Cicada, Death's Actuary, Invigilator). Once detected and at long range, destroy the pirate ships with particle barbette fire and missiles while remaining beyond the reach of their laser armament. Do not target the disabled yacht Lyonesse II.

intents.rationale: Opening range away from the pirate pack to reach Very Long band while going Active to detect the ambushers so we can target them at range.

plan: Invigilator and Death's Actuary burn full thrust to pursue and intercept HMS Executor, attempting to close range despite Executor's higher velocity. Cicada supports with missile fire against Executor from standoff distance. The interceptors maintain active locks to prevent the stealthed target from breaking contact.

intents.rationale: Continue missile fire at HMS Executor while keeping safe distance.
Burn maximum available thrust to intercept Executor and lock onto her.
Maintain intercept trajectory toward Executor while reserving 1 G for evasion.

plan: Keep opening the range to hold at Very Long against the pirate ships where their beam lasers cannot reach us. Focus particle barbette fire and missile salvos on the interceptors first to eliminate their pursuit capability. Utilize active sensors and sensor locks now that our position is already revealed.

intents.rationale: We are already detected, so lock Invigilator, assist gunners, and fire our particle barbette and missiles to destroy her at Long range while keeping distance.

plan: HMS Executor is burning away at 6 G and will cross into Distant next round unless pursued at maximum acceleration. Invigilator and Death's Actuary release dodge reserves and burn maximum 3 G to chase, while Cicada fires missiles to keep pressure on the fleeing raider. Interceptor sensors attempt to lock Executor to aid detection and fire control before she slips contact.

intents.rationale: Continue launching stand-off missiles at Executor to harass her while staying well back.
Burn full 3 G to minimise Executor's rate of opening and attempt sensor lock.
Burn full 3 G in pursuit of Executor to prevent her breaking contact past Distant.

plan: Hold at Very Long range against the enemy interceptors where our particle barbette can strike with impunity while their beam lasers cannot reach. Maintain sensor lock and concentrate barbette and missile fire on Invigilator until destroyed, then shift to Death's Actuary. Manage closure/separation so contacts do not slip past Very Long into Distant.

intents.rationale: Hold range at Very Long to pound Invigilator with particle barbette and missiles while staying well out of their beam laser range, repairing weapon damage.

plan: HMS Executor is escaping at 6 G into Distant range and out of our reach, while four inbound missiles threaten Invigilator. Invigilator must prioritize survival: dodge at full reserve, jam incoming missiles, and maintain distance to ensure President Yang survives. Death's Actuary and Cicada stand by to screen and defend while we prepare point defense for incoming ordinance.

intents.rationale: Cicada stands clear of combat range, tracking contacts and conserving ammunition.
Escort and screen Invigilator, preparing laser turrets to swat missiles targeting the President's ship.
President Yang's ship reserves maximum thrust for evasive maneuvers and EW against the incoming missile salvos while falling back.

plan: Maintain engagement at Very Long range where our particle barbette outranges enemy beam lasers. Hold range against Invigilator to prevent the targets from opening out to Distant, and continue heavy fire until Invigilator is destroyed before switching focus to Death's Actuary. Pilot assists gunners and captain boosts fire to maximize barbette and missile damage.

intents.rationale: Hold Invigilator at Very Long range to prevent them slipping into Distant while finishing her off with particle barbette and missile fire safely beyond their beam range.

plan: Invigilator has been lost, leaving Death's Actuary and Cicada to engage HMS Executor. Death's Actuary will burn to close range with HMS Executor to bring beam lasers into reach while maintaining dodge reserves, while Cicada supports with missile fire from a safe distance and relays sensor data.

intents.rationale: Maintain safe distance while launching missiles at HMS Executor using shared telemetry from Death's Actuary.
Attempt sensor lock and close range at maximum available thrust toward Medium band where our beam lasers can strike.

plan: Maintain engagement against Death's Actuary at Very Long range where our particle barbette and missiles dominate while outranging their beam lasers entirely. Lock the target, assist gunners, boost attacks, and hold range to prevent Death's Actuary from either closing into laser reach or slipping away past Distant.

intents.rationale: We hold Death's Actuary at Very Long range where its beam lasers cannot return fire, locking and firing all mounts to destroy it safely.

plan: With Invigilator lost, Death's Actuary and Cicada must eliminate HMS Executor. Death's Actuary burns to close into beam range while maintaining dodge reserves to mitigate incoming particle barbette fire, and Cicada fires missiles from standoff range using shared targeting data.

intents.rationale: Cicada engages Executor with long-range missiles from safety while sharing telemetry.
Close the distance to bring beam lasers into range while maximizing dodge against the lethal particle barbette and repairing damaged systems.

plan: Keep Death's Actuary at Very Long range where our particle barbette and missiles strike with impunity while completely outranging their beam lasers. Maintain lock, assist gunners, boost gunnery, and batter Death's Actuary until destroyed or disabled.

intents.rationale: Death's Actuary is closing but still at Very Long range; fire the particle barbette and launch missiles while holding range safely outside their beam laser reach.

plan: Death's Actuary cannot survive particle barbette fire at Very Long while sitting at 25% hull, so she breaks lock, maximizes dodge and repair, while holding active contact. Cicada engages HMS Executor with missiles at standoff range using shared data.

intents.rationale: Fire missiles at HMS Executor using shared targeting data while maintaining standoff distance.
Break lock, evade particle barbette fire, open range to survive, and maintain sensor track for Cicada's missile fire.

plan: Keep Death's Actuary at Very Long range where our particle barbette strikes with impunity while completely outranging their beam lasers. Maintain lock, assist gunners, boost fire, and pound Death's Actuary until neutralized.

intents.rationale: Death's Actuary has only beam lasers (Medium range) and cannot return fire at Very Long; keep her at arm's length and eliminate her with barbette and missile fire.
